item.tib: me ri dpa' bo gyad phur gyi dbang rin chen 'bar ba
item.coloph: dbang rin chen 'bar ba'o/ bla ma g.yung drung lha rtse la sogs/ bla ma lha bsgom/ 'or sgom ring mo/ 'ol sgom kun 'dul/ bla ma 'bum rje 'od nas brgyud do/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnam bzhi la sogs mi nub rgyal mtshan lta bu'i bon/ gyad phur dbang gi las chog 'di/ gsang ba 'dus pa man chad nas/ rtogs ldan dad shes chen po yan chad du/ mu tig shel 'phreng lta bu ru/ gong 'og rim bzhin rgyun ma chad par rdzogs so/ bkra shis par shog/
